connector.name: Agenticmemory
connector.registryDescription: Persistent memory for AI agents - history, context, semantic search, queues. 17 tools, stdio/SSE.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.agenticmemory.ai over server sent events, also runs locally from the npm package agmry. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jyswee account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using your Agentic Memory API key: 'Bearer amk_...'. Optional for tool discovery; required to call a tool. Get one instantly with `npx agmry signup my-project`.

env.name: AGMRY_API_KEY
env.description: Agentic Memory API key (amk_...). Optional for tool discovery; required to call a tool. Get one instantly with `agmry signup my-project` — no browser, no card, live for 48h; $0 card-auth starts the free 7-day trial.
